models.label: Model Architecture
models.title: Deep Time Series Model Architecture
models.subtitle: Explore the deep time series model architectures powering this platform, built on THU's Time-Series-Library, integrating multiple state-of-the-art models.

cnn.desc: Extracts local temporal patterns via sliding convolution kernels, capturing translation-invariant features of price formations.
cnn.detail: Sliding convolution kernels scan along the time axis, extracting local morphological features from price sequences. Each convolutional layer captures temporal patterns at different scales.

rnn.desc: Processes time series recurrently, with hidden states propagating across time steps to model sequential dependencies.
rnn.detail: Hidden state h_t propagates along time steps, fusing current input x_t with the previous hidden state h_{t-1} at each step to model temporal dependencies.

transformer.desc: Parallel sequence processing via multi-head self-attention, capturing global temporal dependencies.
transformer.detail: Query, Key, and Value matrices are computed in parallel via Scaled Dot-Product Attention — each position attends to every other position.

timesnet.desc: Transforms 1D time series into 2D tensors, using convolutions to capture multi-period patterns. ICLR 2023.
timesnet.detail: TimesBlock reshapes 1D sequences into 2D tensors, extracts cross-period patterns via Inception modules, then flattens back to 1D output. The key innovation lies in discovering the multi-periodicity of time series.

autoformer.desc: Replaces self-attention with auto-correlation mechanism, progressively decomposing seasonal-trend components. NeurIPS 2021.
autoformer.detail: The auto-correlation mechanism replaces traditional self-attention, discovering period-based dependencies via Fast Fourier Transform. Progressive decomposition decouples complex time series into long-term trends and seasonal fluctuations.

nonstationary.desc: Eliminates non-stationary noise through series stationarization, enhancing Transformer prediction on non-stationary time series. NeurIPS 2022.
nonstationary.detail: A two-stage normalization-destationarization process eliminates distribution drift, enabling Transformers to efficiently model non-stationary sequences while preserving original distribution information.

dlinear.desc: Minimalist linear model challenging complex architectures — efficient time series forecasting via decomposition plus linear mapping. AAAI 2023.
dlinear.detail: Decomposes time series into trend and seasonal components, then uses two simple linear layers to predict each — achieving performance comparable to complex models at extremely low computational cost.

informer.desc: ProbSparse self-attention reduces complexity; self-attention distilling accelerates long sequence forecasting. AAAI 2021 Best Paper.
informer.detail: ProbSparse self-attention focuses only on Top-u key Queries, reducing complexity from O(L²) to O(L log L); distilling operations progressively shorten sequence length, significantly accelerating long-sequence forecasting.

patchtst.desc: Segments time series into patches (sub-sequences), encodes local semantic information via Transformer. ICLR 2023.
patchtst.detail: Long sequences are split into overlapping Patches, each encoded by a Transformer to capture semantic information within local windows, then aggregated into global predictions.

itransformer.desc: Inverts the traditional Transformer architecture, treating variables as tokens to capture cross-variable dependencies. ICLR 2024.
itransformer.detail: A paradigm shift: variables become tokens and time steps become feature channels. Self-attention captures cross-variable relationships — better suited for multivariate financial time series.

xgb.desc: Classic gradient boosting ensemble model, efficiently handling tabular features with outstanding performance in quantitative factor combination.
xgb.detail: Gradient-boosted ensemble of trees, iteratively adding weak learners to minimize residuals with a regularized objective to prevent overfitting. Robust performance on structured factor features.

about.label: About
about.title: About the Project
about.subtitle: AI Quant Research Platform — An AI-powered quantitative trading research platform.
about.backgroundP1: The theoretical framework of this platform draws from the Meta-labeling methodology described by Marcos López de Prado in his 2018 book 《Advances in Financial Machine Learning》.
about.backgroundP2: The core idea of Meta-labeling is: the primary model generates candidate trading signals, then a secondary model performs a second-pass quality assessment of those signals. This architecture effectively filters false positive signals, significantly improving the Sharpe ratio and win rate of strategies.
about.backgroundP3: Building on this foundation, we integrate Deep Time Series Models as the core inference engine, based on THU's Time-Series-Library, covering Transformer, Autoformer, TimesNet, Informer, PatchTST, iTransformer and other cutting-edge architectures to achieve high-precision modeling and forecasting of market time series patterns.
about.strategy1Desc: Captures divergence signals between price and MACD indicators, combined with the Triple Barrier Method (profit-taking/stop-loss/time barriers) for label training, with final trading signals produced by deep time series model inference.
about.strategy2Desc: Market features are nonlinearly transformed through fuzzy membership functions, combined with Bayesian optimization to efficiently search for optimal strategy configurations in parameter space, with final signal-level inference and decision-making by deep time series models.

performance.title: Return Rankings
performance.sharpeDescription: Sharpe ratio measures risk-adjusted returns — higher is better. Generally >1 is acceptable, >2 is excellent.

strategyDescs.fuzzy_ma: Adaptive moving average strategy based on fuzzy inference. Uses Kalman filtering to estimate price trend parameters, with avmood indicator determining buy/sell direction. avmood > 0 indicates bullish, avmood < 0 indicates bearish.
strategyDescs.tea_radical_nature: Trend-following strategy based on MACD divergence signals and Triple Barrier Method. Uses deep time series model inference to identify effective divergence signals and capture trading opportunities at trend turning points.
